learning_curve.sampling: nested hash-ranked domain/private tenant groups; all rows of selected groups; row fractions approximate; fixed seed; no label-based sampling
learning_curve.fit_transformations: refit vocabulary, IDF and numeric scaler on each reduced fitting subset; full-data endpoint is the verified frozen control with the same recipe
learning_curve.limitations: single nested seed, fixed calibration/threshold/tune corpus; no repeated-training uncertainty or extrapolation to infinite data

candidates.name: plus_iscx_fit
candidates.condition: new fitting rows include >=100 hard benign (scheme-free length >120 or path slash count >=4) or >=100 private-host phishing; otherwise report data gap, no ineffective augmentation

weights: base inverse-sqrt domain counts, equal total mass per source; each optional factor applied before renormalization to equal source mass and mean one; no class relabeling
representation: existing versioned experiment sanitizer; original runtime representation untouched
calibration: separate unchanged calibration corpus; source-equal sigmoid C=1000/max_iter=200; positive slope; every new classifier calibrated independently
threshold_rule: maximum of per-source empirical FPR-bound cutoffs on threshold partition only; primary budget fixed before scoring; secondary budgets descriptive, never selected by test

selection.data: unchanged tune only; curve models ineligible
selection.detection_gate: macro source recall gain >=0.02; no supported-source recall loss >0.03; macro Brier increase <=0.001; no source Brier increase >0.005; no source FPR increase >0.0025
selection.calibration_gate: macro Brier reduction >=0.002; macro recall loss <=0.005; no supported-source recall loss >0.005; no source Brier increase >0.005; no source FPR increase >0.0025
selection.structure_guard: private and non-private slices with >=20 positives must lose <=0.005 recall; slices with >=100 benign must increase FPR <=0.0025
selection.ranking: eligible detection first by macro recall, minimum source recall, lower macro Brier; then eligible calibration by lower Brier; otherwise retain control
selection.failed_gate_diagnostic: freeze best new candidate by macro recall then minimum recall and lower Brier; explicitly ineligible if control retained; no selection revisions after test

sources.name: ebbu2017
sources.license: no explicit dataset license found; public author research release, no redistribution/commercial-clearance claim

sources.name: iscx2016_replica
sources.license: research-author benchmark replica in MIT repository; original data rights not established by code license; no redistribution/commercial-clearance claim
sources.provenance_limit: replica bytes pinned; original publisher download currently form-gated, cannot independently establish byte equality

intake.exposure: historical registry, every sidecar, original caches, actual development and prior tests including ALL 169393 latest reserved rows; deduplicate/conflict-screen jointly then prohibit shared domains across the two new sources; all Ebbu rows reserved as external only; no score-based exclusions
intake.screening_order: remove cross-publisher domain overlap from ISCX eligibility, preserving Ebbu external-only; register all supported inputs including exclusions in new sidecar
intake.privacy: raw bytes memory only; persist sanitized URL cache in ignored local storage; heuristic redaction is not full anonymization; no target URL visits

external_evaluation: freeze selected and diagnostic artifacts, thresholds and hashes before scoring either new cohort; compare original v6, retained research control and frozen challenger; previously observed 50000 global test is regression only; no publisher labels become Indonesian gold
